gameModes.name: Confession Roulette
gameModes.tagline: Real answers. Fake answers. Who's bluffing?
coreLoop: Show a spicy or funny campus prompt to all players.
Each player privately submits a short answer or picks a fictional decoy answer.
Submissions are mixed internally with ghost decoys from ghostAnswers.
Reveal answers one at a time with zero authorship.
30 seconds interrogation phase: players vote for the author or select 'Ghost / Decoy'.
Reveal authorship, trigger optional Chaos Powers, and award points.

Each player privately chooses 'I Have', 'I Haven't', or 'Skip'.
Reveal only aggregate counts by default to protect player privacy.
If Detective Mode is enabled and exactly one person chose 'I Have', the group can guess.
Players may always decline follow-ups without penalty.

statement.hinglish: Backlog aana failure nahi, engineering personality ka canon event hai.
statement.en: Having backlogs isn't failure; it's essential engineering character development.

statement.hinglish: 75% attendance rule sirf ego satisfying mechanism hai, padhai se lena dena nahi.
statement.en: The 75% attendance rule is pure ego satisfaction; it has zero learning value.

statement.hinglish: Online certificates aur badges resume pe time-waste hain, koi recruiter nahi dekhta.
statement.en: Online completion certificates are total resume fluff; recruiters ignore them.

statement.hinglish: Hostel wale students day scholars se zyada life aur crisis management seekhte hain.
statement.en: Hostelers learn far better real-world crisis management than day scholars.

statement.hinglish: Group projects mein freeloading karna bhi ek high-level corporate negotiation skill hai.
statement.en: Freeloading in group projects is actually an advanced corporate political skill.

statement.hinglish: DSA aur LeetCode grind karna intelligence nahi, brute force ratta marna hai.
statement.en: Grinding 500 LeetCode problems isn't smartness; it's brute force memorization.

statement.hinglish: Mess ka khana itna kharab hona zaroori hai taaki students kettle cooking master karein.
statement.en: Terrible mess food is necessary so students develop life-long cooking survival skills.

statement.hinglish: Mass recruiter companies ko gaali dene wale placement day pe sabse pehle wahi baithte hain.
statement.en: Those who mock mass recruiters are the very first in line when placement opens.

statement.hinglish: College ke fests pe lakho kharch karna useless hai jab labs mein instruments na ho.
statement.en: Spending millions on fest celebrities while labs have broken meters is absurd.

statement.hinglish: Viva mein marks knowledge ke nahi, bas eye-contact aur confident posture ke milte hain.
statement.en: Viva marks are 90% body language and posture, 10% actual subject knowledge.

statement.hinglish: Proxy lagwana crime nahi, wing brotherhood ka mandatory fundamental duty hai.
statement.en: Calling a proxy isn't cheating; it is an unspoken fundamental brotherhood duty.

statement.hinglish: College CGPA sirf pehle job interview tak matter karta hai, uske baad koi nahi poochta.
statement.en: College CGPA stops mattering five minutes after your very first corporate job.

statement.hinglish: Engineers ko 4 saal mein engineering ke alawa duniya ka har kaam seekhne ko milta hai.
statement.en: Engineers learn literally everything about survival in 4 years except engineering.

statement.hinglish: Hackathon jeetne ke liye coding se 10 guna zyada fancy PPT aur dramatic story chahiye.
statement.en: Winning hackathons is 90% dramatic slide storytelling and 10% actual code.

statement.hinglish: Roommate agar introverted ho to wo blessing hai, over-enthusiastic roommate nightmare hota hai.
statement.en: A quiet introvert roommate is a blessing; an over-enthusiastic one is a nightmare.

statement.hinglish: LinkedIn culture pura toxic mutual admiration club ban chuka hai.
statement.en: LinkedIn has devolved into a dystopian circle of fake mutual admiration.

statement.hinglish: One-night study sessions mein 4 mahine ke syllabus se zyada clarity aati hai.
statement.en: One frantic night of exam study brings more clarity than 4 months of lectures.

statement.hinglish: Strict professors andar se bohot insecure hote hain isliye strictness ka mask pehante hain.
statement.en: Overly strict professors act harsh only to mask their own teaching insecurity.

statement.en: A 10-rupee campus tapri cutting chai beats a 400-rupee Starbucks cup any day.

statement.hinglish: Engineering drawing manual se karwana 2026 mein torture hai jab CAD tools exist karte hain.
statement.en: Drawing manual isometric sheets in 2026 is pure torture when CAD tools exist.

statement.en: Becoming Class Representative is the single worst voluntary mistake a student can make.
